title: Purpose & Calling
intro: A three-year-old's purpose is to help, badly and enthusiastically. That is not a rehearsal for a real life; it is a real life. This month tells a small child that they are useful now, that being helpful is joyful, and that God is not waiting for them to grow up.

keyScriptures.text: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.
Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young.

weeks.title: You Are Useful Now
weeks.declaration: You are not waiting to be useful when you are big. You are useful today, in this house, at your size.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, help us let our child help, even when it is slower. Amen.

weeks.title: God Made You for Good Things
weeks.declaration: God made you to do good things, and He already knows what they are. Some of them are for today.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, thank You that this small life has a purpose we did not invent. Amen.

weeks.title: Helping Is Happy
weeks.declaration: Helping someone makes you feel good inside. That is not an accident — it is how you were made.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let our child find joy in helping rather than duty. Amen.

weeks.title: You Are Good at Things
weeks.declaration: There are things you are good at, and there will be more. God gave them to you on purpose.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, show us what You have put in our child, and let us say it out loud. Amen.

days.title: Useful Today
days.declaration: You are useful today, at your size. Not one day when you are bigger.

scripture.text: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young.

days.title: Made for Good Things
days.declaration: God made you to do good things. He already knows what they are.

scripture.text: We are God's handiwork, created to do good works.

days.title: Helping Feels Good
days.declaration: Helping someone makes you feel good inside. That is how you were made.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: You Are Good at Things
days.declaration: There are things you are good at. There will be lots more.

scripture.text: We have different gifts.

days.title: God Has a Plan
days.declaration: God has a plan for your whole life, and it is a good one.

scripture.text: I know the plans I have for you.

days.title: Little Jobs Count
days.declaration: Carrying one plate is a real job. Little jobs are not pretend.

scripture.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little.

days.title: Growing Is Your Work
days.declaration: Growing and learning is your work right now. You are doing it well.

scripture.text: The child grew and became strong.

days.title: Nobody Else Is You
days.declaration: There are things only you can do, because nobody else is you.

scripture.text: God has placed the parts just as he wanted them.

days.title: Trying Counts
days.declaration: Trying counts even when it goes wrong. We are glad you tried.

scripture.text: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might.

days.title: God Uses Children
days.declaration: God has always used children to do important things. You are not too small.

scripture.text: Speak, for your servant is listening.

days.title: Practise Now
days.declaration: What you practise now, you will be able to do later. Nothing is wasted.

scripture.text: Start children off on the way they should go.

days.title: Doing It Properly
days.declaration: Doing something properly feels better than rushing it. Try the slow way.

scripture.text: Work at it with all your heart.

days.title: Noticing What Is Needed
days.declaration: Look around and see what is needed. That is how helping starts.

scripture.text: Look to the interests of others.

days.title: You Do Not Have to Know Yet
days.declaration: You do not have to know what you will be when you grow up. Not for years.

scripture.text: He will make your paths straight.

days.title: Made Different on Purpose
days.declaration: You were not made to be like anyone else. Different was the plan.

scripture.text: You knit me together.

days.title: Being Kind Is a Job
days.declaration: Being kind is real work and it makes a real difference. Do lots of it.

scripture.text: Let us do good to all people.

days.title: Boring Bits Matter
days.declaration: Some jobs are boring and still matter. Tidying up is one of them.

scripture.text: The plans of the diligent lead to profit.

days.title: Finish It
days.declaration: Finishing what you started feels good. Try to get to the end.

scripture.text: Let us not become weary in doing good.

days.title: God Made Your Hands
days.declaration: God made your hands to build things and help people. Use them for both.

scripture.text: Establish the work of our hands.

days.title: Someone Needs You
days.declaration: Somebody today needs exactly what you can do. Keep your eyes open.

scripture.text: Use whatever gift you have received to serve others.

days.title: Not a Race
days.declaration: This is not a race against anybody. You are going at your own speed.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Learning Is Good Work
days.declaration: Asking questions and learning things is proper work. Keep doing it.

scripture.text: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge.

days.title: Willing Helps
days.declaration: Being willing matters more than being good at it. Willing is a choice.

scripture.text: Here am I. Send me!

days.title: Where You Are
days.declaration: You cannot do the next thing yet. Be here first, and here is enough.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything.

days.title: Born Now on Purpose
days.declaration: You were born now, not any other time. God chose when.

scripture.text: He marked out their appointed times.

days.title: Being Good at Something
days.declaration: When you are good at something, it is a gift to use, not to show off.

scripture.text: He has filled him with the Spirit of God.

days.title: Failing Is Fine
days.declaration: Being bad at one thing tells you nothing except that it is not your thing yet.

scripture.text: The Lord establishes their steps.

days.title: God Finishes Things
days.declaration: God started something good in you and He does not give up halfway.

scripture.text: He will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Small Now, Not Small Always
days.declaration: You are small now. You will not always be, and your job will grow with you.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Made to Enjoy It
days.declaration: You were made to enjoy what you do. God is not against that.

scripture.text: There is nothing better than to enjoy their work.

days.title: Take It With You
days.declaration: What you helped with today mattered. Do some more of it tomorrow.

scripture.text: Prepared in advance for us to do.
